movementType.description: Defines what kind of terrain the unit will be able to move, along with other properties. Can use only one: NONE, LAND, AIR, WATER, HOVER, BUILDING, OVER_CLIFF, OVER_CLIFF_WATER

name.example: This also works for stripIndex in [effect_#], with frames set through frameIndex

mass.description: The 'weight' of the unit, defines how it collides with other units, a greater value means it's tougher to push.

radius.description: Circular area around the unit that makes it selectable. (mouse click/screen touch)

price.description: The price of your action for the unit. Disables action if not available. Defaults to credits if unlabelled
price.example: price: credits=5, energy=5, hp=100, shield=5, ammo=1

maxHp.description: The max health for the unit. (will spawn with this value).

buildSpeed.description: Sets how fast the action has to be queued before doing the action behaviors

class.description: Reserved for future use, must be CustomUnitMetadata by default.

techLevel.description: Usually used in BR maps, controls the size of safe zone markers and damaging borders. 1 techLevel = 10x10 tiles = 200 pixels in diameter

altNames.description: Comma separated list of names. Like name but lower priority, useful for multiple optional mods.

strictLevel.description: Defaults to 0. 1 = Errors if keys are duplicated. Add to "all-units.template" in root to apply to all units.

isBio.description: Choose whether the unit is bioligical or not, affects sound and splat (unless hideScorchMark:true)

isBug.description: Changes some death defaults, and sort order in Sandbox.

isBuilder.description: Normally required if this unit places buildings. Defaults to [ai]useAsBuilder.

streamingCost.description: Like price but paid for overtime while this unit is being queued or built. Construction or queue is paused if resources run out while building.

switchPriceWithStreamingCost.description: Shortcut to set streamingCost to price value and clear price, add to all-units.template to quickly switch a mod over to streaming resources.

maxShield.description: The max shield hitpoints of the unit. Can start with 0 hitpoints if startShieldAtZero:true.

startShieldAtZero.description: Unit starts with a 0 hitpoints shield on created if true.

energyMax.description: Defaults to 0. Energy that can be used as ammo for turrets, laser defense and actions.

energyStartingPercentage.description: Sets the percentage of charged energy when the unit is first built.

energyNeedsToRechargeToFull.description: Disables weapons using energy after reaching zero till fully recharged if true.

armour.description: Damage taken away from each hit. (not currently used in any vanilla units)

armourMinDamageToKeep.description: Min damage to keep from received damage. Defaults to 1.

borrowResourcesWhileAlive.description: Takes these resources when created and returns them when removed or destroyed.

borrowResourcesWhileBuilt.description: Like borrowResourcesWhileAlive but doesn't take affect till built. Mostly useful for buildings like houses that have negative resources to add to the unit cap, etc.

generation_delay.description: How often generation_resources/credits is added. Defaults to 40. (changing not recommended)

showInEditor.description: Set to false to hide unit in Sandbox editor. (Defaults to true)

displayText.description: The unit name that the game shows to the player.

displayText_{LANG}.description: LANG = ISO 639-1 Code to show this text instead when game is in this language.

displayDescription.description: Unit description that the game shows to the player.

displayDescription_{LANG}.description: LANG = ISO 639-1 Code to show this text instead when game is in this language.

displayLocaleKey.description: Translation file key for unit name and description.

displayRadius.description: Defaults to radius value. Set to show a larger or smaller selection circle UI on units.

uiTargetRadius.description: Defaults to displayRadius value. Radius used when attacking/reclaiming/etc this unit

shieldRenderRadius.description: Defaults is a little bigger than radius. Set to show a larger or smaller shield circle on units.

shieldDisplayOnlyDeflection.description: Hide shield unless deflecting shot if true.

shieldDeflectionDisplayRate.description: Defaults to 4. High value causes shield deflection to fade disappear faster.

showOnMinimap.description: Defaults to true. Hide units on minimap if false.

showActionsWithMixedSelectionIfOtherUnit.description: Shows a merged action list if all units selected includes one of these tags. Useful for converted units.

isBuilding.description: Defines if the unit is a building.

footprint.description: Left, up, right, down. Tiles taken up which block unit movement. Defaults to 0,0,0,0  = 1 center tile.

constructionFootprint.description: Tiles taken up for placement of other buildings. Defaults to 0,0,0,0 = 1 center tile.

displayFootprint.description: Left, up, right, down. Only applies to buildings, just used for GUI. Defaults to footprint.

buildingSelectionOffset.description: Defaults to 0. Adds or removes padding on the drawn selection rect in UI.

buildingToFootprintOffsetX.description: Defaults to 10. Change the building position in the footprint on the X-axis.

buildingToFootprintOffsetY.description: Defaults to 10. Change the building position in the footprint on the Y-axis.

placeOnlyOnResPool.description: Normally used for extractors, forces building construction in a resource pool.

selfBuildRate.description: Rate unit builds itself when placed without a builder.

ignoreInUnitCapCalculation.description: defaults to true for buildings otherwise false. Set to true to not count this unit in unit cap.

copyFrom.description: Copy from another leg. Useful to only need to set leg values once

dont_load.description: Do not load unit, and don't error on missing data. Can be useful when used with copyFrom.

overrideAndReplace.description: Overrides another unit with this unit. Build links and map positions to target unit will be replaced.

onNewMapSpawn.description: Values: emptyResourcePools_asNeutral, emptyOrOccupiedResourcePools_asNeutral, mapCenter_asNeutral, mapCenter_eachActiveTeam, spawnPoint_eachActiveTeam (1.15)

isLocked.description: Defaults false. If true action is disabled, and a lock icon is shown. Mostly used for no nuke game modes

isLockedIfGameModeNoNuke.description: Disallows building of this unit if nukes are disabled during match setup.

experimental.description: Tag unit as experimental. Affects zoomed out icon and end game stats.

stayNeutral.description: Set to false to disable capture when unit is on the neutral team.

createNeutral.description: Set to true to always spawn the unit on the neutral team.

createOnAggressiveTeam.description: Set to true to always spawn the unit on aggressive teams on single player matches.

tags.description: Sets varied tags depending on what is specified, can be multiple with comma as separator

defineUnitMemory.description: Can define several variables for custom storage, unique for each unit. Allowed types: boolean, float/number, unit, string.
defineUnitMemory.example: defineUnitMemory: boolean nukeActive, boolean laserReady, float experience, unit nextTarget, unit homeBase, string customText

fogOfWarSightRange.description: Sets number of tiles this unit can see through the fog of war. Defaults to 15.

fogOfWarSightRangeWhileNotBuilt.description: Fog of War range when unit/building is incomplete. Defaults to fogOfWarSightRange

softCollisionOnAll.description: Creates a soft collision effect when touching other units.

disableAllUnitCollisions.description: Unit cannot collide with others if true.

isUnrepairableUnit.description: No unit can repair this unit if true.

isUnselectable.description: Defaults to false. When true, the player cannot click the attachment.

isUnselectableAsTarget.description: Defaults to isUnselectable. Can be used to create units that cannot be selected but can be targeted for attack, reclaim, etc

isPickableStartingUnit.description: If true, unit is added to dropdowns for starting unit in game setup menus.

startFallingWhenStartingUnit.description: Unit will appear falling from skies when starting unit if true.

soundOnAttackOrder.description: List of sound names. Only one will be played on each attack order. Only .ogg and .wav formats.

soundOnMoveOrder.description: List of sound names. Only one will be played on each move order. Only .ogg and .wav formats.

soundOnNewSelection.description: List of sound names. Only one will be played on each unit selection. Only .ogg and .wav formats.

canNotBeDirectlyAttacked.description: No unit can directly target this unit. If true this will also skip this unit in victory/defeat checks. If true, canNotBeDamaged is true by default

canNotBeDamaged.description: Defaults to value of canNotBeDirectlyAttacked (be careful setting this without canNotBeDirectlyAttacked, as AI will attack forever)

canNotBeGivenOrdersByPlayer.description: If true unit will not take player or AI orders.

canOnlyBeAttackedByUnitsWithTags.description: List of tag strings, only units with these tags can directly target this unit.

disableDeathOnZeroHp.description: Setting to true allows unit to continue living even at 0 HP, useful for custom "death" action. Warning: If not used with an autoTrigger, etc units will attack this unit forever.

allowCaptureWhenNeutralByAI.description: When true, it lets to be captured on contact by AI as well. Defaults as false

transportSlotsNeeded.description: Defaults to 1. Number of slots this unit uses up in a transport, experimentals are often set to 5.

maxTransportingUnits.description: Number of slots this units has for transporting other units.

transportUnitsRequireTag.description: Only allows trasport of units that have one of these tags.

transportUnitsRequireMovementType.description: Only allows trasport of units that have one of these movement types.

transportUnitsBlockAirAndWaterUnits.description: Defaults to true. This unit can only transport LAND units if true.

transportUnitsEachUnitAlwaysUsesSingleSl.description: Defaults to false. Units in this transport occupy 1 slot always if true, ignoring transportSlotsNeeded.

transportUnitsKeepBuiltUnits.description: Makes built units stay inside transport instead of exiting it once ready if true.

transportUnitsCanUnloadUnits.description: Defaults to: if not self.isOverLiquid() and not self.isMoving(). This unit cannot unload units if false.

transportUnitsAddUnloadOption.description: Defines if unload button should be added to the unit menu

transportUnitsUnloadDelayBetweenEachUnit.description: Changes the delay it takes between each unit getting unloaded.

transportUnitsKillOnDeath.description: Defaults to true. If false transported units don't die when transport dies.

transportUnitsHealBy.description: Rate to heal units that are being transported.

transportUnitsBlockOtherTransports.description: Defaults to true, if false this transports can hold other transports.

whileNeutralTransportAnyTeam.description: This unit can transport units of any team while neutral if true.

whileNeutralConvertToTransportedTeam.description: Converts this unit to transported team while neutral. Useful with whileNeutralTransportAnyTeam.

convertToNeutralIfNotTransporting.description: Reverts back this unit to neutral when unloaded. Useful with whileNeutralTransportAnyTeam.

transportUnitsOnTeamChangeKeepCurrentTea.description: Keeps transported units on their orginal team when this unit is converted if true.

resourceRate.description: Used with canReclaimResources. Allows other teams to reclaim this unit. Normally used with neutral team. Use price to set what resources are gained.

similarResourcesHaveTag.description: When this has been reclaimed harvester unit moves on to another resource with these tags.

resourceMaxConcurrentReclaimingThis.description: Defaults to unlimited. Set to restict how many units can reclaim this resource at the same time.

reclaimPrice.description: Like price but for resources. Useful for buildable resources.

canReclaimResources.description: If true this unit can gather resources, useful with resourceRate.

canReclaimResourcesNextSearchRange.description: Defines the resource search range of this unit when its main gathered resource runs out.

canReclaimResourcesOnlyWithTags.description: This unit is only allowed to gather resources with these tags.

canReclaimUnitsOnlyWithTags.description: This is for reclaiming units, not for resources. See canReclaimResourcesOnlyWithTags

resourceReclaimMultiplier.description: Multiplies the builder's reclaim speed. Different from the related key "nanoUnbuildSpeed"

canRepairUnitsOnlyWithTags.description: Repairs units with the specified tags

canRepairBuildings.description: Can this can heal ally buildings (isBuilder:true is required)

canRepairUnits.description: Can this can heal ally units. (isBuilder:true is required), canRepairBuildings required for buildings.

autoRepair.description: Automatically try and repair damaged units in nano range. (isBuilder:true is required)

nanoRange.description: Defaults to 85. Defines the unit building/repair/reclaim range.

nanoRepairSpeed.description: Defaults to 0.2. Defines the unit nano repair/reclaim speed.

nanoBuildSpeed.description: Defaults to 1. Defines the unit nano building speed. (May multiply with target's buildSpeed)

nanoUnbuildSpeed.description: How fast a builder reclaims an incomplete building (defaults to 1)

nanoReclaimSpeed.description: How fast a builder reclaims a normal unit (not a resource unit)

nanoRangeForRepairIsMelee.description: Defines if this unit must touch its target to repair it.

nanoRangeForReclaimIsMelee.description: Defines if this unit must touch its target to reclaim it.

nanoRangeForRepair.description: Defines a specific range for the repair action of this unit.

nanoRangeForReclaim.description: Defines a specific range for the reclaim action of this unit.

nanoFactorySpeed.description: Defaults to 1. Multiplies the buildSpeed value of the created unit if this unit is a factory.

extraBuildRangeWhenBuildingThis.description: Temporarily adds extra build range to builders to build this unit. Useful for water based buildings.

builtFrom_{NUM}_name.description: Useful if adding this unit to build to existing buildings. Like canBuild but in opposite direction.

builtFrom_{NUM}_pos.description: Order this build link appears in UI. Using canBuild instead is more recommended.

builtFrom_{NUM}_forceNano.description: Build as if this is a building if true. (even if it's a unit)

builtFrom_{NUM}_isLocked.description: If true this unit cannot be built in this build link. (can be conditioned if logicBooleans are used)

builtFrom_{NUM}_isLockedMessage.description: Message shown when this build link is locked.

exit_x.description: Where created or unloaded units appears from the transport or building. Defaults to 0.

exit_y.description: Where created or unloaded units appears from the transport or building. Defaults to 5.

exit_dirOffset.description: Defaults to 180 for units and 0 for buildings. Defines the exit direction of created or unloaded units.

exit_heightOffset.description: Defaults to 0. Defines the height where created or unloaded units appears.

exit_moveAwayAmount.description: Defaults to 70. Defines the distance that created or unloaded units moves from this unit.

exitHeightIgnoreParent.description: Ignores parent height for exit height; useful for separating attachments with their parents for building

dieOnConstruct.description: Deletes this unit when it starts to build if true. (target building/unit likely will need selfBuildRate set)

dieOnZeroEnergy.description: Kills this unit if energy level reaches zero when true.

numBitsOnDeath.description: Defines the number of scattered bit fragments when this unit dies.

nukeOnDeath.description: Unit will spawn a nuke detonation built-in effect when dies if true.

nukeOnDeathRange.description: Defines the nuke effect range when using nukeOnDeath.

nukeOnDeathDamage.description: Defines the nuke effect area damage when using nukeOnDeath.

nukeOnDeathDisableWhenNoNuke.description: Defaults to false. If true this unit will not explode with nuke when nukes are disabled in skirmish maps.

fireTurretXAtSelfOnDeath.description: Auto-shoot a specific turret when this unit dies.

explodeOnDeath.description: Defaults to true. Disables the unit death explode built-in effect if false.

explodeOnDeathGroundCollision.description: Defaults to true. Disables the explode built-in effect on death when unit touches ground if false.

explodeTypeOnDeath.description: options: verysmall, small, normal, large, largeUnit, building, buildingNoShockwaveOrSmoke, verylargeBuilding

effectOnDeath.description: Spawns built-in or custom effects when unit dies.

effectOnDeathGroundCollision.description: Like effectOnDeath but when unit touches ground. Useful for flying units.

unitsSpawnedOnDeath.description: Spawns these units when dies. Comma separated unit identifiers.

unitsSpawnedOnDeath_setToTeamOfLastAttac.description: Units spawned on death will appear on the last attacker team if true.

hideScorchMark.description: Disables the death scorch mark leaved when unit dies if true.

soundOnDeath.description: Sets a custom sound for this unit death.

effectOnDeathIfUnbuilt.description: If the unit was not completed, and is destroyed, play this effect. Defaults to effectOnDeath

autoTriggerCooldownTime.description: Post automatic action cooldown (Not detection cooldown). Defaults to 1s. Warning: Setting this too low for many units might effect performance depending on the action effects.

autoTriggerCooldownTime_allowDangerousHi.description: Allows for auto action cooldown lower than 0.2s. Default to false. Not recommended.

autoTriggerCheckRate.description: options: everyFrame (default), every4Frames, every8Frames. This overrides autoTriggerCheckRate set on [core] Note: all triggers regardless of check rate are checked when first created and after an auto trigger cooldown. Note: Adding [core]autoTriggerCheckRate:every8Frames to all-units.template could have a large performance boost for mods with complex autoTriggers.

autoTriggerCheckWhileNotBuilt.description: Defaults to false. autoTrigger of unit actions check even when not completely built if true

updateUnitMemory.description: Faster memory update than [action_#] setUnitMemory. Useful on many applications.

updateUnitMemoryRate.description: Sets how often the memory is updated. Defaults at 1s. settings it to 0 will update memory every frame.

pos.description: Order action appears in UI. Merges with positions from canBuild buttons

tech.description: Tech level. Mostly just affects build link colour in this unit UI. Defaults to 1.

forceNano.description: Builds target as if it was a building if true. (even if it's a unit)

isVisible.description: Dynamic Value, draws the decal on a specific condition

isLockedMessage.description: Shows the message when the isLocked's condition is met

isLockedMessage_{LANG}.description: LANG = ISO 639-1 Code to show this text instead when game is in this language.

isLockedAlt.description: Another reason for this to be locked. Can just use OR on isLocked, but this allows a different message to be shown

isLockedAlt2Message.example: isLockedAlt2Message: Explosive stockpile is heavily damaged.

addResources.description: Give spawn unit those resources, can be used to set flags that trigger actions

isGuiBlinking.description: Flashes in UI to draw attention to it. Might be annoying if used often, recommended only for temporarily states/messages

image.description: Takes a single image for the decal - NOT TO BE CONFUSED WITH IMAGE STACK

teamColoringMode.description: How pixels are used for team coloring, options: pureGreen, hueAdd, hueShift, disabled
teamColoringMode.example: (Defaults to pureGreen if no code) teamColoringMode: disabled

image_back.description: An optional image drawn behind other units. Useful for factories that units exit

image_shield.description: Image to show as a custom shield

image_wreak.description: Image to use when unit dies. Can be NONE to leave no wreak

image_offsetX.description: Use this to adjust the graphics of a unit if it is too far off one side

image_offsetY.description: Use this to adjust the graphics of a unit if it is too far off one side

image_offsetH.description: Use this to adjust the height of the graphic, especially when using decals

image_floatingPointSize.description: Fixes of by 1 pixel sizing for images with widths and/or height that has odd value

isVisibleToEnemies.description: Only visible to player and allies when false. Recommend with showOnMinimapToEnemies. Useful for stealth units.

scaleImagesTo.description: Resize image to fit this value in pixels.  Effects leg, and shadow images as well.

drawLayer.description: Land units normally default to ground or ground2 if transport. Options: wreaks, underwater, bottom, ground, ground2, experimentals, air, top

whenBeingBuiltMakeTransparentTill.description: How long the transparent effect is applied to incomplete units, set to 0 to disable completely. Default: 1

icon_zoomed_out.description: Sets the custom image of the unit icon on the zoomed out battle map

icon_zoomed_out_neverShow.description: Sets wheather show the unit icon or not on the zoomed out battle map

icon_build.description: Displays icon of the unit on Build Panel

image_turret.description: Default image for all turrets, can also be set per turret

teamColorsOnTurret.description: Defaults false. Apply team colours on turret as well. Also effects pre-turret images

scaleTurretImagesTo.description: Will cause crash if image_turret is not specified, even if image is set per turret

lock_body_rotation_with_main_turret.description: Locks body image locked to the direction of the turret named "1" (turret_1) or the first turret defined (if a turret_1 is not defined)

lock_leg_rotation_with_main_turret.description: Locks legs and arms to the direction of the turret named "1" (turret_1) or the first turret defined (if a turret_1 is not defined)

image_shadow.description: Sets shadow for the decal. Note that AUTO does not work in this key.

shadowOffsetX.description: Sets the horizontal position of the decal's shadow

shadowOffsetY.description: Sets the vertical position of the decal's shadow

image_shadow_frames.description: If shadow image should use frame animation of main image. .Alternative to AUTO_ANIMATED shadow value.

lock_shadow_rotation_with_main_turret.description: Locks body image shadow locked to first turret's direction

total_frames.description: Sets the number of frames in an image from an imageStack that uses a spritesheet.

frame_width.description: Sets the frame width in the decal stack

frame_height.description: Sets the frame height in the decal stack

default_frame.description: Default frame when not playing an animation. First frame is 0

splastEffect.description: True to create a water wave effect when over water. Default false

dustEffect.description: True to create a dust effect when over land. Default false

splastEffectReverse.description: True to also create effect when unit is reversing

dustEffectReverse.description: True to also create effect when unit is reversing

movementEffect.description: Custom movement effect, can be anything

movementEffectRate.description: Sets the frequency of effects being spawned while moving

movementEffectReverseFlipEffects.description: Create effect as if unit has rotated 180 when reversing

repairEffect.description: Custom repair effect, can be anything. Replaces default effect from builders

repairEffectAtTarget.description: Custom repair effect towards the repaired target

repairEffectRate.description: Sets the frequency of effects being spawned while repairing. Defaults to 5, affects both sides.

reclaimEffect.description: Custom reclaim effect, can be anything. Replaces default effect from builders

reclaimEffectAtTarget.description: Custom reclaim effect towards the reclaimed target

reclaimEffectRate.description: Sets the frequency of effects being spawned while reclaiming. Defaults to 5, affects both sides.

rotate_with_direction.description: Defaults to true. Makes unit body image locked to 0 degrees when false. Often used with animation_direction_*

animation_direction_units.description: 45 for 8 directions, 90 for 4 direction animation. Used with rotate_with_direction:false

animation_direction_strideX.description: Animation frames to offset on direction change.

animation_direction_strideY.description: Animation frames to offset on direction change. Used with frame_height.

disableLowHpFire.description: Defaults to false. When true, removes the flames on severely damaged unit/structure.

disableLowHpSmoke.description: Defaults to false. When true, removes the smokes on severely damaged unit/structure.

showTransportBar.description: Defaults to true. Shows the transport bar for transport units.

showHealthBar.description: Defaults to true. Shows the health bar of a unit. (Still hidden even if true when "Always show unit health" setting is disabled.)

showEnergyBar.description: Defaults to true. Shows the energy bar of a unit.

showShieldBar.description: Defaults to true. Shows the shield bar of a unit. Also affects the presence of set custom shield sprite.

showQueueBar.description: Defaults to true. Shows the bar for build or action queue of a unit.

showShotDelayBar.description: Defaults to true. Shows the shot delay/warmup of a unit before firing.

showSelectionIndicator.description: Defaults to true. Shows select circle/box if true

teamColorsUseHue.description: False: Green pixels on unit gets converted to team color. True: Whole unit is tinted the team colour. Defaults to false

animation_TYPE_start.description: TYPE can be set to: attack, moving, idle. Use [animation] section instead for more control

animation_TYPE_end.description: End frame, must be larger then start

animation_TYPE_scale_start.description: Scale unit image. Defaults to 1. Useful for bio units or breathing effects.

animation_TYPE_scale_end.description: Scale unit image. Defaults to 1. Useful for bio units or breathing effects.

animation_TYPE_speed.description: Delay for each frame of animation. Larger values cause slower animation

animation_TYPE_pingPong.description: Play animation in reverse before repeating. Useful with scale_start/scale_end

canAttack.description: Defaults to true. Set to false to stop this attachment attacking.

canAttackFlyingUnits.description: Narrows targeting for this turret, note targeting for the whole unit in [attack] is applied first. (so you can only use this to target less not more)

canAttackLandUnits.description: Default true. If false unit cannot attack surface units.

canAttackUnderwaterUnits.description: Default true. If false unit cannot attack underwaterunits.

shootDelay.description: Global delay, can also use delay on each turret. Set in seconds or ticks

canAttackNotTouchingWaterUnits.description: Default true. If false unit can only attack units in contact with the water. Used for units with torpedos.

canOnlyAttackUnitsWithTags.description: Only attacks potential targets with specific tags

canOnlyAttackUnitsWithoutTags.description: Only attacks potential targets without specific tags

turretMultiTargeting.description: Allow each turrets to fire at a different target at the same time. Very useful if [turret]limitingAngle is used

isMelee.description: Used with a low attack range (like maxAttackRange: 9) makes src and target radius get added to range, and effects AI.

meleeEngangementDistance.description: Makes unit move to attack nearby units. Defaults to 250 for melee, and 0 for non melee (Works even if non-melee, but might be unexpected to players)

turretRotateWithBody.description: Are all turrets rotated when body rotates. Defaults to true

attackMovement.description: normal/bomber. bomber attack movement will retreat when energy runs out

isFixedFiring.description: Must aim body at target to shoot. Will often make the unit need to stop before it can aim and shoot.

aimOffsetSpread.description: Sets the shot inaccuracy. 0 will make all shots land on target's center

stopTargetingAfterFiring.description: Unit stops targeting after firing a shot. Rarely used or needed.

disablePassiveTargeting.description: Unit only attacks manually ordered target. Rarely used or needed.

showRangeUIGuide.description: Defaults to true. Displays the attack range for this turret

shootDelayMultiplier.description: Defaults to 1. Can be dynamically changed with setUnitStats

shootDamageMultiplier.description: Defaults to 1. Can be dynamically changed with setUnitStats

x.description: Sets the horiztontal position of the attachment

y.description: Sets the vertical position of the attachment

altProjectile.description: Alternative projectile fired from this turret when altProjectileCondition is true

barrelX.description: Defaults to 0. Controls horizontal position for projectile spawn.

barrelY.description: Defaults to size. Note: size and barrelY have the same meaning

barrelHeight.description: Height of barrel in 3d. Effect projectile and shoot flame starting height

height.description: Sets the elevation of the attachment

size.description: Controls the distance between the center of the turret and the point from where projectiles spawn.

turnSpeed.description: Limits the turn speed of a projectile, making them inaccurate even with directDamage. Zero value will make it act like if targetGround is set true, but air target friendly option.

turnSpeedAcceleration.description: Defaults to disabled, and full turn speed is used.

turnSpeedDeceleration.description: Defaults to turnSpeedAcceleration. Setting this higher than turn acceleration might allow faster targets to be hit

idleDir.description: Sets the direction of the attachment when idle

idleDirReversing.description: Sets the direction of the attachment when the base unit is moving in reverse

shouldResetTurret.description: Defaults true. False to disable the reseting turret angle when idle

idleSpin.description: Spin rate when idle, used on missile turrets

idleSweepAngle.description: Disabled by default. Controls how far the turret will "look" left and right

idleSweepDelay.description: Controls the delay between idleSweep movements

idleSweepSpeed.description: Controls the speed with which the turret sweeps when idle

idleSweepAddRandomDelay.description: Default 1-20 depends on idleSweepDelay, used to stop sweep syncing up with other units

attachedTo.description: A specific turret to connect to, it will rotate with it. No correlation to [attachment_x]

slave.description: Locks this turret's direction and shot cooldown to attached turret. Often used with warmup for multiple barrel guns

isMainNanoTurret.description: Defaults to false. Turret to use for creating buildings, etc. should only be true on one turret, and should have canShoot set to false

energyUsage.description: Required energy to fire weapon. Same as resourceUsage: energy=X

resourceUsage.description: can be in credits/energy/hp/shield/ammo. Stops firing if not met
resourceUsage.example: resourceUsage: credits=5, energy=5, hp=100, shield=5, ammo=1

delay.description: Override global shootDelay for this turret

linkDelayWithTurret.description: When this other turret fires the cooldown delay on this turret will be reset/removed

warmupCallDownRate.description: Rate to reduce warmup when turret is not ready to fire at any targets

warmupNoReset.description: Defaults to false. When true warmup is not reset after firing a shot and turret doesn't wait for warnup. Used with warmupCallDownRate and warmupShootDelayTransfer.

warmupShootDelayTransfer.description: Defaults to 0, amount to reduces the next shot delay depending on warmup. When used with warmupNoReset, can make a each shot faster.

barrelOffsetX_onOddShots.description: 0 by default. Sets a barrelX offset only during odd numbered shots, useful for twin-barreled units. Use with barrelX. Use the opposite value of barrelX for most cases.

canAttackCondition.description: Normally, used to optionally disable a turret based on a LogicBoolean. Eg: this unit's height

canAttackMaxAngle.description: Max angle to target for turret to be allowed for fire. Defaults to 5, don't set lower. Can be set to 181 for turrets that don't need to turn to fire missiles.

clearTurretTargetAfterFiring.description: Clears the turrets sub-target when using multi-targeting

limitingRange.description: Make this turret have less range than the maxAttackRange. Do not apply this to all turrets change maxAttackRange instead.

limitingAngle.description: Linked with idleDir. Turret will only be able to fire at units +/- this angle.

interceptProjectiles_andTargetingGroundU.description: Minimum distance required for intercepting projectile

interceptProjectiles_andUnderDistance.description: Defaults to 2000, distance inflight before firing

interceptProjectiles_andOverHeight.description: Defaults to 0. Sets the projectile target height limit

laserDefenceEnergyUse.description: Set to enable a projectile laser defence from this turret. Should also set the energyMax in core.

invisible.description: When true, the projectile is not rendered but still functional.

image_applyTeamColors.description: When true, the specific turret applies team colors over the special greens in the sprite.

image_drawOffsetX.description: Moves the image horizontally from the turret center.

image_drawOffsetY.description: Moves the image verticallly from the turret center.

chargeEffectImage.description: Used with warmup. Shows a scaling effect image on turret barrel when charging.

warmupStartEffect.description: Spawns specified effects when the specific turret is charging/warming up

shoot_sound.description: Can be linked to an .ogg or .wav file, or one of the default game sounds (list at bottom of reference)
shoot_sound.example: shoot_sound: tank_firing | shoot_sound: missile.wav | shoot_sound: ROOT:audio/shoot.ogg

shoot_sound_vol.description: Sets the volume of the shoot sound

shoot_flame.description: Current types are: small, large, smoke, shockwave, or CUSTOM: effectSectionName

shoot_light.description: Produces a colored light upon shooting. Uses hexcode in either RGB or ARGB format

onShoot_playAnimation.description: Play a custom animation from an [animation] section after firing this turret

onShoot_triggerActions.description: Trigger these actions each time this turret fires

unloadUpToXUnitsAndGiveAttackOrder.description: Unloads X units at turret barrel locations and gives them the attack order of turret target

recoilOffset.description: Push turret forward or back after firing for a recoil effect. Value in pixels.

recoilOutTime.description: Time to get to offset position after firing

recoilReturnTime.description: Time to return to default position

life.description: Defaults 200. Time till effect is removed. Set low as possible to reduce effect overhead.

deflectionPower.description: Defaults to 1. Energy needed for laser defence to deflect. -1 to disable deflection (only disable for special weapons like flames)

explodeOnEndOfLife.description: Default to false. True to explode at end of life with all side effects and area damage instead of disappearing. Good for making area-denial weapons.

autoTargetingOnDeadTarget.description: Retarget to nearby unit if target dies while in transit

autoTargetingOnDeadTargetRange.description: The range which it will select a new target if old target has died

autoTargetingOnDeadTargetLead.description: The lead it will try to have on the new target

unloadUpToXUnitsFromSource.description: Unload X units from source unit, to projectile explode location

teleportSource.description: Move unit that shot this projectile to projectile explode location

spawnUnit.description: Spawn new units of this type at projectile explode location

spawnProjectilesOnEndOfLife.description: Spawns new projectiles on end of life, useful for secondary projectiles

spawnProjectilesOnExplode.description: Projectiles to spawns when this projectile hits it's target

spawnProjectilesOnCreate.description: Spawns projectiles on creation of this projectile, useful for making true shotgun-like projectile spread

convertHitToSourceTeam.description: Convert units hit to the team that fired this projectile. Useful to make capturing systems

flameWeapon.description: Generates small flames on hit (only cosmetic)

delayedStartTimer.description: Hide for x time before showing and updating effect.

directDamage.description: Damage to target unit on hit. Does not work with targetGround:true as it won't have a clear unit to target

areaDamage.description: Damages on arrival of target with an area effect, use areaRadius to adjust size of damage. targetGround needs this to damage

areaRadius.description: How wide areaDamage effects. Note this drops off (unless areaDamageNoFalloff is used)

areaRadiusFromEdge.description: Applies damage from edge of units instead of center. Mostly effects large units.

areaExpandTime.description: Applies area damage as an expanding blast wave rather than instantly. Useful for nuke projectiles

areaIgnoreUnitsCloserThan.description: Units closer than this range aren't effected. Rarely needed. Not recommended for normal projectiles.

shieldDamageMultiplier.description: Defaults to 1.  0 to do no damage to shields and 2 to do double damage

shieldDefectionMultiplier.description: Defaults to 1. The amount of shield to bypass. 0 to ignore shields and directly damage hull

hullDamageMultiplier.description: Defaults to 1. Can be used to create EMP weapons that affect shields only. 0 to ignore hull and only damage shields

ignoreParentShootDamageMultiplier.description: Sets whether multipliers are applied or not regardless of multipliers set in attack or setUnitStats

armourIgnoreAmount.description: Amount of armour to ignore on target and do damage as if this armour was not there

friendlyFire.description: Lets area effect projectiles damage own team units (can't damage allies). Useful for nuke-like weapons
friendlyFire.example: friendlyFire: false / friendlyFire: true / friendlyFire: only-ignoreEnemy

mutatorX_ifUnitWithTags.description: Applies mutators to this projectile if target has corresponding tags

mutatorX_ifUnitWithoutTags.description: Same as ifUnitWithTags, but applies if target doesn't have the set tags

mutatorX_directDamageMultiplier.description: Changes directDamage. Defaults to 1. Be careful not to confuse players using this as the effect may not be clear. Use amour instead when possible. Replace X with desired name

mutatorX_areaDamageMultiplier.description: Same as directDamageMultiplier but for areaDamage. Defaults to 1.

mutatorX_changedExplodeEffect.description: Change explode effect if this mutator is active. Eg make a bounce off amour effect. Helps to make the damage change more clear to players (Doesn't work with targetGround.)

mutatorX_addResourcesDirectHit.description: Add resource to all direct hit units. Warning: Be careful not be break units from other mods by adding random resources or energy to them that they don't expect.

mutatorX_addResourcesAreaHit.description: Add resource to all area hit units. Warning: Be careful not be break units from other mods by adding random resources or energy to them that they don't expect.

targetGround.description: Target ground, and don't home in on target. Note: only areaDamage is applied if targeting ground.

targetGround_includeTargetHeight.description: Default false. for area affect AA weapons

targetGroundHeightOffset.description: Default 0. for shooting over or under a target. Useful for projectiles that split and rain down.

targetSpeedAcceleration.description: Controls the speed rampup for targetSpeed

ballistic.description: Makes projectiles fly up into the air and come down, instead of going in a straight line

ballistic_delaymove_height.description: Sets up to how high the projectile needs to be before moving normally

ballistic_height.description: Sets the target height of the projectile

targetGroundSpread.description: Randomly makes the shot inaccurate by this amount. Also used by weapons like the flamethrower

speedSpread.description: Randomly change the starting projectile speed by this amount

instantReuseLast.description: Recycles last projectile fired, only one projectile ever exists. Can turn lasers into beam weapons by using lower rate of fire and setting this to true

instantReuseLast_alsoChangeTurretAim.description: Make turret's aim include last projectile's spread and sweep offsets, useful for beam weapons

instantReuseLast_keepAreaDamageList.description: Default false. Keeping the list was the normal behaviour in 1.13 making area damage not apply a second time but this is not useful. Use this only if you want the old behaviour.

interceptProjectile_removeTargetLifeOnly.description: Defaults to false. When false projectiles are just removed. Could be true to make hit projectiles explode or split when hit

disableLeadTargeting.description: Disable the lead targeting calculations when aiming at a moving target. Defaults false.

leadTargetingSpeedCalculation.description: The expected speed of this projectile for targetGround lead target calculation. Defaults to 'targetSpeed' if set otherwise 'speed'.

initialUnguidedSpeedHeight.description: Sets vertical speed for projectiles with targetGround. Use gravity to make smooth arching projectiles. Better have gravity value slightly slower than this key to produce the arches.

gravity.description: Controls the pull for projectiles that target ground. Use together with initialUnguidedSpeedHeight

wobbleAmplitude.description: How wide the projectile will wobble

wobbleFrequency.description: How often the projectile will wobble

pushForce.description: Push (or pull with a negative value) the units that get hit. Divided by target mass

pushVelocity.description: Push (or pull with a negative value) the units that get hit. Ignores target mass

moveWithParent.description: Move projectile as parent moves. Useful for beam effects that need to stick to source turret.

sweepOffsetFromTargetRadius.description: Add to sweep offset by factor of target's radius. 0.4 would be 40%

retargetingInFlight.description: Can retarget a new target mid-flight, perfect for flak-style weapons and projectiles that collide

retargetingInFlightSearchDelay.description: How long between searching for new targets. Default 5

retargetingInFlightSearchRange.description: Range which targets are reselected. Default 120

retargetingInFlightSearchLead.description: The lead of the projectile to try to hit the target. Default 15

retargetingInFlightSearchOnlyTags.description: Only retarget units with these tags

color.description: Sets the color of the drawn line

drawType.description: Defaults to normal. Changes how effect is rendered.  Options: normal|displacement   (displacement only shows when shader effects are turned on)

explodeEffect.description: Produces the specified effects upon explosion.

explodeEffectOnShield.description: Use this effect if shield is active on target

teamColorRatio.description: Sets team coloration between 0-1. Team color is dependent from source unit

teamColorRatio_sourceRatio.description: default is (1-teamColorRatio). Keep more of color when mixing. Note this might saturate colors.

drawUnderUnits.description: Renders the effect under all units

effectOnCreate.description: Produces specified effects upon creation of the projectile.

shouldRevealFog.description: Reveal fog to player on explode

alwaysVisibleInFog.description: Renders the projectile even when fog is present

nukeWeapon.description: Shows on mini-map when fired. Some other side effects as well, like nuke explosion effect

trailEffect.description: true for built-in defaults, but can also point to any custom effects

lightSize.description: Sets the size of the light emitted by the projectile. 1 value = 1 tile

lightColor.description: Sets the color of the light emitted by the projectile. Uses hexcode in either RGB or ARGB format

largeHitEffect.description: Creates a large explosion and accompanying sound on hit (only cosmetic)

lightingEffect.description: Draw as lighting works best with instant:true

laserEffect.description: Draw as laser works best with instant:true

beamImage.description: Image to use for beam and laser effect type projectiles. Image is repeated vertically depending on the distance to target. Beam image should be 20 pixels or longer. Width does not matter, only the height.

beamImageOffsetRate.description: Sets how fast the beam image moves towards or away from the target

beamImageStart.description: Sprite for the origin point of the custom beam

beamImageStartRotated.description: Defaults false. True to rotate with turret angle

beamImageEnd.description: Sprite for the end point of the custom beam

slowDeathFall.description: Used with large aircraft. Makes the unit fall slowly while maintaining its speed at the time of death.

moveSpeed.description: Sets how fast the leg moves while walking

moveAccelerationSpeed.description: Defines how fast units accelerate to max speed.

moveDecelerationSpeed.description: Don't make this too low or units will have trouble stopping at waypoints

reverseSpeedPercentage.description: 0.6 default. Over 0.4 will reverse for short distances (at 40% speed). If set to 1 will drive in reverse same as forwards. Useful if slow turning

landOnGround.description: Should flying unit land when idle.

targetHeightDrift.description: Smooth animated height change. Defaults to 0 but if AIR movementType default is 1.5

startingHeightOffset.description: Sets the initial height on spawn. Defaults at 0.

heightChangeRate.description: Rate at which the unit changes height, either from converting or drifting

fallingAcceleration.description: The acceleration in which a unit drops

maxTurnSpeed.description: Sets the top turning speed of a unit

turnAcceleration.description: Defines how fast units accelerate to max turn speed.

moveSlidingMode.description: Makes the unit slide when moveDecelerationSpeed is lower, making them drift and feel natural

moveIgnoringBody.description: Allows the unit to move without fully turning in the direction its moving, useful for ships and air units

joinsGroupFormations.description: Defaults to true. Changing not recommended. When false, the unit will directly move to the assigned waypoint without taking space consideration from neighboring units.

useAsBuilder.description: Set to true if unit can build or repair buildings. Defaults to [core]isBuilder.

useAsTransport.description: Defaults to true if unit can transport units

useAsHarvester.description: Defaults to true if unit can reclaim resources

disableUse.description: Disallow AI building this unit or building

aiTags.description: SPECULATIVE - sets separate set of tags for AI use

ai_upgradePriority.description: Defaults to 0.06. Set between 0-1, higher means AI is more likely to upgrade this unit before others

maxGlobal.description: Maximum amount allowed for a specific structure for an AI team per map

maxEachBase.description: Maximum amount allowed for a specific structure for an AI team per "base", usually around an extractor or spawn point. To check for an AI base in sandbox, enable Debug Mode and Click Shift + F3

buildPriority.description: 0-1. AI uses 0.8 for first land factory, 0.48 for air factory, 0.47 for first turret.

noneInBaseExtraPriority.description: Adds to buildPriority, if this unit doesn't exist in the AIs base

noneGlobalExtraPriority.description: Adds to buildPriority, if this unit doesn't exist in the any where on the map

recommendedInEachBasePriorityIfUnmet.description: Defaults to 0.5. Overrides buildPriority if recommended in base is too low.

upgradedFrom.description: Create link to another unit to preserve max counts for upgraded and non-upgraded types in same base.

lowPriorityTargetForOtherUnits.description: Useful for units that cannot attack back. Eg walls

whenUsingAsHarvester_recommendedInEachBa.description: Assigns unit of the same name with certain amount on an AI base

whenUsingAsHarvester_recommendedGlobal.description: Assigns unit of the same name with certain amount on map

whenUsingAsHarvester_includeOtherHarvest.description: Includes all harvester types on a single counter

onlyUseAsHarvester_ifBaseHasUnitTagged.description: Only sets the harvester unit as a harvester if an AI base has a unit with particular tag(s)

attach_x.description: Sets the leg's attach point on the X axis.

attach_y.description: Sets the leg's attach point on the Y axis.

rotateSpeed.description: Sets the leg's rotation speed on movement

endDirOffset.description: Target foot/end rotation relative to body

lockMovement.description: Lock to unit body. Useful if walking unit converted to a flying unit.

heightSpeed.description: Sets how fast the leg rises while walking

holdDisMin.description: Defaults to 7. Reposition leg at this distance if neighbor legs are not already repositioning.

holdDisMax.description: Defaults to 16. Force reposition of leg at this distance. Repositions leg at this distance even if a neighboring leg is moving

holdDisMin_maxMovingLegs.description: Sets maximum amount of legs to check before applying distance holding

hold_moveOnlyIfFurthest.description: Defaults to true. When true, starting moving leg only if it is currently the furthest leg from where it should be.

holdDisMin_checkNeighbours.description: Checks neighbors before applying distance holding

hardLimit.description: Defaults to 50. Force leg to never go this far. Better to not be reached.

estimatingPositionMultiplier.description: defaults to 1. Predicts were unit will be for leg placement based on unit speed.

hidden.description: Hide this resource from the player

image_end.description: Sets the main arm end sprite

image_end_shadow.description: Sets the shadow for the arm

image_end_teamColors.description: When true, the arm end will apply team colors

image_foot.description: same as image_end, but acts as the foot for the leg

image_foot_shadow.description: Sets the shadow for the foot

drawDirOffset.description: Rotates the foot/arm sprite to a specified direction

dust_effect.description: Spawns dust particles on each step.

spinRate.description: Makes arm/leg spin, like idleSpin for turrets. Great for helicopters

favourOppositeSideNeighbours.description: calculate neighbours with X 10 times closer than Y

drawLegWhenZoomedOut.description: For performance, defaults changes based on unit size

drawFootWhenZoomedOut.description: For performance, defaults changes based on unit size

targetHeightRelative.description: Apply height relative to unit's height

onCreateSpawnUnitOf.description: Upon spawning the unit, specified attached unit is also spawned as attachment

canBeAttackedAndDamaged.description: When true, the attachment is vulnerable to attacks

deattachIfWantingToMove.description: If the unit is ordered to move, it will detach. This includes waypoints from actions.

lockLegMovement.description: Locks the leg movement while attached.

setDrawLayerOnTop.description: Renders the attachment above the base unit

setDrawLayerOnBottom.description: Renders the attachment below the base unit

addTransportedUnits.description: Often used with transport units, when true, attaches one of the unit passenger to this attachment slot

lockRotation.description: When true, stops the attachment  from rotating

rotateWithParent.description: When true, the attachment rotates with the parent unit

prioritizeParentsMainTarget.description: It will priotize targeting the main target. Defaults to true.

alwaysAllowedToAttackParentsMainTarget.description: Will always attack the parents main target.

onParentTeamChangeKeepCurrentTeam.description: Defaults false. If true attached units are not converted when parent changes team. Eg from [projectile]convertHitToSourceTeam

onConvertKeepExistingUnitInSameSlot.description: When true, the attachment is retained on the same attachment slot when the parent is converted to another unit

unloadInCurrentPosition.description: Defaults false. If true transported attached units are kept current attached location when unloading

keepWaypointsNeedingMovement.description: Defaults false. If true attached units keep waypoints with movement even while they cannot move. Useful if they will be automatically deattached soon.

showAllActionsFrom.description: Show all actions of the units attached in the parent unit list when selected

createIncompleteIfParentIs.description: If parent hasn't been built, create attachment with the same built value. Links built values till attachment is complete. Useful for buildings built with nano.

redirectDamageToParent.description: Redirects damage done to this attachment to the parent instead of damaging itself directly

redirectDamageToParent_shieldOnly.description: When enemies attack the attachment, all damage are redirected to the parent's shield

text.description: Labels the action. Supports dynamic text

textPostFix.description: Text shown as suffix, useful with textAddUnitName to create text UI

text_{LANG}.description: Alternative text for different language. Use ISO 639-1 Language code on the {LANG} prefix. Supports dynamic text

description.description: Sets the description of the mod package. Doesn't support line breaks.
description.example: description: This is a sample of mod that samples a unit to the game

description_{LANG}.description: Alternative description for different language. Use ISO 639-1 Language code on the {LANG} prefix. Supports dynamic text
description_{LANG}.example: description_es: Disparos en el área objetivo

displayType.description: Affects how the action button and text is displayed. Options: none, rally, upgrade, queueUnit, building, action, infoOnly, infoOnlyNoBox, infoOnlyStockpile

displayRemainingStockpile.description: Queue is shown as number of times action can be triggered based on price. Use dynamic text on text as alternative.

iconImage.description: Shows a custom icon for the specific resource in the HUD and in text

iconExtraImage.description: Drawn over top of icon image. Useful for upgrade icons, etc

iconExtraIsVisible.description: When the condition is met, the extras for icon is visible.

unitShownInUI.description: Display this unit. (as if this action built this unit)
unitShownInUI.example: eg: unitShownInUI: unitRef self.transporting(slot=0)  or  unitShownInUI: heavyTank

guiBuildUnit.description: Uses the UI similar when building structures. An alternative to fireTurretX on some cases

setBuilt.description: Designates how built the unit is from a percentage of 0-100% with a number between 0 and 1.

id.description: Can be set to anything. The ID to refer to for dependency of other mods

textAddUnitName.description: Add this unit's name to this action's text

descriptionAddFromUnit.description: Add this unit's description to this action's description

descriptionAddUnitStats.description: Add this unit's stats (eg HP, energy, resources) to this action's description

unitShownInUIWithHpBar.description: default true, Only used when unitShownInUI is a unitRef

unitShownInUIWithProgressBar.description: default true, Only used when unitShownInUI is a unitRef. Replaces HP bar if active

alwaysSinglePress.description: Defaults false. When true no confirmation needed on mobile, when used with canPlayerCancel:false and allowMultipleInQueue:false will also hide the queue interface.

isActive.description: Defaults true. If false then action is disabled and shown in red in UI.

allowMultipleInQueue.description: When false makes it so only one action can be queued of this type (useful for keeping actions with conditions from being spammed)

onlyOneUnitAtATime.description: When action is picked in UI, only one unit selected with get this action. Defaults to false.

isAlsoViewableByAllies.description: Allows ally players to see actions from this unit, useful for showing stats to other players (eg missile count, items collected)

isAlsoViewableByEnemies.description: Allows enemy players to see actions from this unit, useful for showing stats to other players (eg missile count, items collected)

ai_isHighPriority.description: Use this for faction selection actions or other high priority actions such as building high priority units

ai_isDisabled.description: Defaults false. Stop AI using this action. (Note when ai_isHighPriority is true this might be ignored)

autoTriggerOnEvent.description: Action will be triggered when an event is happening on a particular unit. Options: created, completeAndActive, destroyed, killedAnyUnit, queuedUnitFinished, queueItemAdded(withActionTag="#"), queueItemCancelled(withActionTag="#"), teleported, touchTargetSuccess, newWaypointGivenByPlayer, teamChanged, transportingNewUnit, transportUnloadedOrRemovedUnit, tookDamage(withTag="#"), newMessage(withTag="#"), enteredTransport, leftTransport, attachmentRemoved. withTag parameter for tookDamage uses tag from projectile and it is optional. withTag parameter for newMessage uses message tags.

autoTriggerOnEventRecursionLimit.description: Defaults to 1. Prevents loops, useful with triggering itself so it doesn't infinitely triggers, good for repeating action effect on event

autoTrigger.description: When true triggers the effects of this action instantly (ignoring price, isActive, isVisible, buildSpeed, etc)
autoTrigger.example: autoTrigger: if self.overWater(), autoTrigger: if self.customTimer(laterThanSeconds=5)

highPriorityQueue.description: Defaults to false. If true this action skips all other low priority actions in queue. Useful for fireTurret actions.

canPlayerCancel.description: Defaults to true. When false, players cannot cancel this particular action.

whenBuilding_cannotMove.description: Stops unit moving while action is being applied. Useful for deploy like actions.

whenBuilding_playAnimation.description: Plays a specified animation while the action is queued.

whenBuilding_rotateTo.description: Rotate unit body to this direction when action is in active queue.

whenBuilding_rotateTo_orBackwards.description: If true allow rotation in 180 degrees from whenBuilding_rotateTo when this is a smaller angle

whenBuilding_rotateTo_waitTillRotated.description: Pause action queue till rotation is finished

whenBuilding_temporarilyConvertTo.description: Convert to another unit while action is in active queue. Note: actions from the original unit will be kept

whenBuilding_temporarilyConvertTo_keepFi.description: Don't change these fields when using whenBuilding_temporarilyConvertTo (both to and from)

whenBuilding_triggerAction.description: While action is queued, another action is triggered.

whenBuilding_rotateTo_aimAtActionTarget.description: While action is queued, the unit is rotated to the target. Often used with fireTurretX actions

whenBuilding_rotateTo_rotateTurretX.description: While action is queued, a specified turret is aimed at the target. Often used with fireTurretX actions

spawnEffectsOnQueue.description: Effects to spawn at unit when action is first added to queue

playSoundToPlayerOnQueue.description: Global sound to play to unit's player only when action is first added to queue

lockCameraToUnitOnQueue.description: Only effects player that triggered the action. Locks the camera on this unit and stops if the player tries to move the camera. If multiple units are triggered, the camera won't lock at all.

addSelectedUnitOnQueue.description: Only effects player that triggered action. Modifies the current active player selection to include in addition the unit references.

setSelectedUnitOnQueue.description: Only effects player that triggered action. Modifies the current active player selection to become the unit references.

requireConditional.description: Skip all effects of this action if this evaluates to false

convertTo.description: Convert your unit into another unit. properties are preserved.

convertTo_keepCurrentTags.description: Keep current and temporarily tags and ignores default tags on convertTo target.

convertTo_keepCurrentFields.description: Don't change these fields when converting, useful with setUnitStats (Allowed fields: maxHp, maxShield, shieldRegen, maxEnergy, armour, mass, shootDelayMultiplier, moveSpeed, maxAttackRange.)

addEnergy.description: Adds energy to unit. Has no effect unless energyMax is set. (Same as addResources: energy=X)

addResourcesScaledByAIHandicaps.description: Same as addResources, but increased or decreased depending on AI difficulty level

addResourcesWithLogic.description: Like addResources but allows logic to be used for the resource value

setResourcesWithLogic.description: Sets target resources to this value instead of adding. Becareful with global resources.

deleteSelf.description: Remove self with no explosions or sounds

setBodyRotation.description: Rotates the unit to a particular direction. Supports dynamic values

addSpeed.description: Adds to the units current speed

setUnitStats.description: Allows changing of a select number of fields dynamically without converting. Supports =/+=/-=, with dynamic maths/logic. Changeable fields: maxHp, hp, maxShield, shield, shieldRegen, maxEnergy, energy, armour, mass, shootDelayMultiplier, shootDamageMultiplier, moveSpeed, maxTurnSpeed, maxAttackRange, fogOfWarSightRange, nanoRange, selfRegenRate, targetHeight, nanoFactorySpeed. (targetHeight adjust the unit's height gradually relative to its current height, unlike setting it with setHeight)

resetUnitStats.description: Reset changes made by setUnitStats to base values

setUnitMemory.description: Change this unit's memory, values can be set with logic. Memory must first be defined with defineUnitMemory

shrinkArrays.description: Clears indexes with null values, shrinking the array

setHeight.description: Changes unit height based on this height value

setCustomTarget1.description: Used for unit linking without requiring unit memories or markers. It is the unit that built this by default.

setCustomTarget2.description: Like setCustomTarget1 and with the same use. It is none by default.

sendMessageTo.description: Sends a message to a targeted unit

sendMessageWithTags.description: Useful for message detection in an autoTriggerOnEvent event, eg autoTriggerOnEvent:newMessage(withTag='xyz')

sendMessageWithData.description: The data that will be sent to the targeted unit. Allows multiple key-value pairs with any dynamic data type, use eventData() to read this data in the event

refundAllQueuedItems.description: Refunds the spent price in the queue of a specific action; Includes set flags in price

removeAllQueuedItemsWithoutRefund.description: Similar to refundAllQueuedItems, but does not refund

alsoTriggerAction.description: Trigger to results of another action as well. Ignores action's requirements.

alsoQueueAction.description: Adds another action into the normal unit's queue. Ignores action's requirements

alsoTriggerOrQueueActionConditional.description: Defaults true. alsoTriggerAction and alsoQueueAction are ignored if this works out to be false.

alsoTriggerOrQueueActionWithTarget.description: Changes the target of the triggered action, normally defaults to the current action target. Effects things like fireTurretXAtGround, spawnUnits, thisActionTarget(), etc

alsoTriggerActionRepeat.description: Repeats the alsoTriggerAction call, thisActionIndex changed on each repeat - Useful to create loops or work with arrays

otherwiseTriggerAction.description: Triggers a different action if autoTrigger or requireConditionals return false. (Serves as the "else" in a generic programming syntax)

playSoundAtUnit.description: Local sound to play when action finishes

playSoundGlobally.description: Global sound to play to all players in game

playSoundToPlayer.description: Global sound to play to unit's player only

fireTurretXAtGround.description: When action finishes fire target turret at point on ground, bypasses canShoot rules in turret.

fireTurretXAtGround_withOffset.description: If not set player targets the ground with GUI, if a point is set this step is skipped

fireTurretXAtGround_withProjectile.description: Used with fireTurretXAtGround. Defaults to target turret's normal projectile.

fireTurretXAtGround_withTarget.description: Fires a turret aimed at the location of the indicated unit or marker

fireTurretXAtGround_count.description: Number of projectiles to fire. Defaults to 1

fireTurretXAtGround_onlyOverPassableTile.description: Only allow tiles crossable by this movement type to be selected (e.g., LAND,BUILDING,WATER,HOVER)

fireTurretXAtGround_showGuideDecals.description: Draws decals at the target location. Recommend setting up decals with layer: inactive

spawnUnits.description: Spawn units at action's target. See 'Spawn units line' section in this doc for details.

produceUnits.description: Like spawnUnits but unit exits as if it was produced normally, and gets a move away waypoint

offsetSelfAbsolute.description: Offsets unit position absolutely by this point. Format: [x,y,height]

teleportTo.description: Changes unit position to this position. Great alternative to fireTurretX with teleporting projectile

addUnitsIntoTransport.description: Creates and add units into transport, use self.transportingCount() to check for space before adding

transportTargetNow.description: {Currently broken in 1.15 - don't use} Instantly tries to transports existing units on the map into this transport. Might fail if rules don't allow this unit to be transported.

forceTransportTargetNow.description: Bypasses all transport checks even if the target is not even a transport. Be careful with usage

deleteNumUnitsFromTransport.description: Removes a specified amount of cargo units

deleteNumUnitsFromTransport_onlyWithTags.description: Removes a specified amount of cargo units, but only those with specified tags

forceUnloadTransportNow.description: For unload all units, or slot targeted by forceUnloadTransportNow_onlyOnSlot. Unloads even if no space or overwater, etc. Take note that the payloads are unloaded on the exit coordinates of the units (exit_x and exit_y in [core] section)

forceUnloadTransportNow_onlyOnSlot.description: Focuses the force unload to a specific slot

clearAllWaypoints.description: Clears all waypoints, be careful not to annoy players by removing their orders, prepending waypoints is often better

addWaypoint_type.description: Adds a waypoint with a specific purpose. Options: move, attackMove, guard, loadInto, loadUp, attack, reclaim, repair, touchTarget, build, follow, setPassiveTarget

addWaypoint_prepend.description: Add to the start of the waypoint queue or the end

addWaypoint_triggerActionIfFailed.description: If target_nearestUnit fails to find a match so waypoint cannot be added then trigger this action

addWaypoint_triggerActionIfMatched.description: Triggers an action if a waypoint is legal

addWaypoint_maxTime.description: Automatically remove this waypoint if it has been active for longer than this time.

addWaypoint_target_nearestUnit_tagged.description: Puts the waypoint to a nearest unit with specific tags

addWaypoint_target_nearestUnit_team.description: Puts the waypoint to a nearest unit with a specific relation to the player's unit. Options: own, neutral, allyNotOwn, ally, enemy, any, notOwn

addWaypoint_target_nearestUnit_maxRange.description: Puts the waypoint to a nearest unit within the maximum range specified.

addWaypoint_target_mapMustBeReachable.description: Puts the waypoint only if the waypoint target is reachable by the unit (e.g., if a unit cannot cross two islands, the waypoint is not placed.)

addWaypoint_target_fromReference.description: Puts the waypoint to a marker or a reference unit

addWaypoint_position_offsetFromSelf.description: Puts the waypoint to an absolute coordinate

addWaypoint_position_fromAction.description: Puts the waypoint taken from an action that triggered this action

addWaypoint_position_randomOffsetFromSel.description: Puts the waypoint to a random relative coordinate

addWaypoint_position_relativeOffsetFromS.description: Puts the waypoint to a relative coordinate

addWaypoint_target_randomUnit_tagged.description: Puts the waypoint to a random unit with specific tags

addWaypoint_target_randomUnit_team.description: Puts the waypoint to a random unit with a specific relation to the player's unit. Options: own, neutral, allyNotOwn, ally, enemy, any, notOwn

addWaypoint_target_randomUnit_maxRange.description: Puts the waypoint to a random unit within the maximum range specified.

addAllActionCooldownsTime.description: Adds cooldown on all actions, including canBuilds

addActionCooldownTime.description: Player cannot use action again for this amount of time

addActionCooldownApplyToActions.description: Sets addActionCooldownTime's target. Defaults to this action.

clearAllActionCooldowns.description: Removes all existing cooldowns on all buttons

playAnimation.description: Plays animation when the action is triggered

playAnimationIfNotPlaying.description: Don't restart animation if this animation is already playing

finishPlayingLastAnimation.description: Finish last animation, including blend out

stopLastAnimation.description: Stop last animation, skipping blend out

switchToNeutralTeam.description: Change team to neutral. This team is allied to all other teams. Will be captured by nearby units unless [core]stayNeutral:true is used

switchToAggressiveTeam.description: Change to a built-in team that is aggressive to all other teams. Does not get captured.

switchToTeam.description: Team id to switch to. Starts at 0. (but -1 for a neutral team, -2 for aggressive Team). Also supports dynamic values

takeResources.description: Resources to take (required to use take resources). And at-least 1 include key is needed.

takeResources_includeUnitsInTransport.description: Includes cargo units in taking resources

takeResources_includeParent.description: Include attachment parent or transport parent

takeResources_includeReference.description: Includes referenced units in taking resources

takeResources_includeUnitsWithinRange.description: Includes all units within the specified range

takeResources_includeUnitsWithinRange_te.description: Used with includeUnitsWithinRange, defaults to own. Can be:  own|ally|allyNotOwn|enemy|neutral|any

takeResources_excludeUnitsWithoutTags.description: Includes all units without the specified tags in taking resources

takeResources_excludeUnitsWithTheseResou.description: Excludes all units with custom prices in them

takeResources_triggerActionIfAnyCollecte.description: Triggers an action if any amount of resources is collected in the current collection action

takeResources_triggerActionIfNoneCollect.description: Triggers an action if no amount of resources is collected in the current collection action

takeResources_triggerActionForEach.description: Calls this action for each unit found by takeResource with the unit as thisActionTarget, and thisActionIndex counting up from zero.

takeResources_discardCollected.description: Just take resources from targets, don't add(or remove) to self

takeResources_keepResourcesOnTarget.description: Don't add/remove resource from target. This clones resources. Use with takeResources_discardCollected and takeResources_triggerActionIfAnyCollected to make a resource detector.

takeResources_maxUnits.description: Defaults to 1. Takes resources from specified amount of units

takeResources_searchOnly.description: Shortcut for maxUnits: 200, discardCollected: true, keepResourcesOnTarget: true to detect resources only

takeResources_directTransferStoppingAtZe.description: If less resources on target than transfer amount, only remaining resources will be transfered. Doesn't support use with some other takeResources_* keys

convertResource_from.description: Name of custom resource to take from

convertResource_to.description: Name of custom resource to give to

convertResource_minAmount.description: Skip if less than this amount in 'from'. Defaults to 0. Likely not needed for most use cases

convertResource_maxAmount.description: Max amount to transfer between 'from' and 'to'

convertResource_multiplyAmountBy.description: Defaults to 1. Amount to multiply when adding on 'to' (does not effect amount taken on 'from')

resourceAmount.description: Name of custom resource to set with the below 3 keys. All keys are optional, and can be used together.

resourceAmount_setValue.description: Absolute value to set this resource to, ignores current value of resource. Skipped by default

resourceAmount_addOtherResource.description: Name of another custom resource to add to this on. Can be used without resourceAmount_setValue, to just add resources. Or with resourceAmount_setValue:0 to copy a resource value.

resourceAmount_multiplyBy.description: Defaults to 1. Multiple the current or new value by

attachments_deleteNumUnits.description: Removes a specified amount of units attached

attachments_onlyOnSlots.description: Restrict attachments_* actions to these attachments

attachments_unload.description: Unload all attachments. Can be used with attachments_onlyOnSlots. Same as unloading transported units

attachments_disconnect.description: Disconnect all attachments in the place they are right now. Can be used with attachments_onlyOnSlots.

disconnectFromParent.description: Disconnects this unit from parent's attachment slot

temporarilyAddTags.description: Add tag to this unit until it is converted or reset (unless convertTo_keepCurrentTags is used)

temporarilyRemoveTags.description: Remove tag from this unit until it is converted or reset (unless convertTo_keepCurrentTags is used)

addGlobalTeamTags.description: Add a tag to player's team. Use with self.globalTeamTags() to create unlocks and upgrades. Unique tags are best to not conflict with other mods.

removeGlobalTeamTags.description: Remove a tag from player's team.

showMessageToPlayer.description: Sends a message to the player controlling the unit
showMessageToPlayer.example: showMessageToPlayer: There is a hidden enemy near your defenses

showMessageToPlayer_{LANG}.description: Note: This format is support on nearly all strings that show to player even when reference doesn't show it. Use ISO 639-1 Language Code on the {LANG} placeholder
showMessageToPlayer_{LANG}.example: showMessageToPlayer_fil: May nakatagong kalaban na malapit sa mga depensa mo

showMessageToAllPlayers.description: Sends a message to all players

showMessageToAllEnemyPlayers.description: Sends a message to all enemy players only

showQuickWarLogToPlayer.description: Sends a Quick War Log message to the player controlling the unit (in the lower lef)

showQuickWarLogToAllPlayers.description: Sends a Quick War Log message to all players (in the lower lef)
showQuickWarLogToAllPlayers.example: showQuickWarLogToAllPlayers: 500 oil sold to allied market

debugMessage.description: Only shows in Sandbox with Debug mode on.

lifeRandom.description: Random offset life by +/- this value

alsoEmitEffects.description: Create more effects when created, useful for meta-effects. Note: other 'alsoEmitEffects' on created effects are ignored.

alsoEmitEffectsOnDeath.description: Create these effects when life runs out.

ifSpawnFailsEmitEffects.description: If 'spawnChance' for this effects fails then emit these effects instead

alsoPlaySound.description: Plays sound upon spawning the effect. Use OGG or WAV audio files. Appending a colon with a float value sets the volume

createWhenOffscreen.description: Defaults false. When true, effect is created when the unit is offscreen

createWhenZoomedOut.description: Defaults true. Effect is created even when the map is zoomed out. Set to false for improving performance

createWhenOverLiquid.description: Defaults true. Effect is created when the unit is over water

createWhenOverLand.description: Defaults true. Effect is created when the unit is over land

spawnChance.description: Chance this projectile will spawn. Defaults to 1.

showInFog.description: Default false. When true, effect is still visible on fog of war

liveAfterAttachedDies.description: Defaults false when attachedToUnit is being used

priority.description: If 2 or mods/units define a resource with the same NAME, the displayName/displayColor with the highest priority is used

attachedToUnit.description: Attach to unit or projectile that created this effect. Will move with this object. Useful for thrust effects

alwayStartDirAtZero.description: Sets the direction of spawned unit to 0 degrees.

atmospheric.description: Apply drag to slow this effect down and add small wind effects

physics.description: Fall to ground and bounces. Needs height to take effect.

physicsGravity.description: Defaults to 1. height speed acceleration when physics: true

xOffsetRelative.description: Sets horizontal offset relative to the unit

yOffsetRelative.description: Sets vertical offset relative to the unit

xSpeedRelative.description: Moves the effect sprite on relative horizontal position with specified speed. Negative will move left relative to source, positive will move right relative to source. Useful for thrust effects for moving units

ySpeedRelative.description: Moves the effect sprite on relative vertical position with specified speed. Negative will move down relative to source, positive will move up relative to source. Useful for thrust effects for moving units

xSpeedAbsolute.description: Moves the effect sprite on absolute horizontal position with specified speed. Negative will move left relative to map, positive will move right relative to map. Useful for smoke effects on structures

ySpeedAbsolute.description: Moves the effect sprite on absolute vertical position with specified speed. Negative will move down relative to map, positive will move up relative to map. Useful for smoke effects on structures

hOffset.description: Sets the height of the whole decal

hSpeed.description: Sets the speed to change the height of the effect

dirOffset.description: Sets the direction of the whole decal.

dirSpeed.description: Sets the rotation speed of the effect

frameIndex.description: Use a specific frame from strip index

frameIndexRandom.description: Use random frame from strip index

stripIndex.description: A built-in image set to use. Cannot be used with custom image. Options: effects/explode_big/light_50/flame/effects/effects2/projectiles/projectiles2/explode_bits

imageShadow.description: Custom image file to use for shadows

scaleTo.description: Defaults to 1. Resizes the unit into the specified scale

scaleFrom.description: Defaults to 1. Resizes the unit from the specified scale

fadeInTime.description: Fade alpha from 0% to 100% for this time at start

fadeOut.description: Fade alpha from 100% to 0% based on life. Set alpha is higher than 1 to delay fade

alpha.description: 0-1, sets transparency of decal (images or line)

shadow.description: True to draw a shadow. Forced true if imageShadow is used

pivotOffset.description: only affects relative offsets without rotating image

pivotOffsetRandom.description: Offsets pivot between +/- of specified value

animateFramePingPong.description: If true, animation will go back and forth within the frames

animateFrameSpeed.description: Sets the animation speed. The lower the value, the slower it plays

animateFrameSpeedRandom.description: Randomizes how fast the effect animation plays
