animateFrameLooping.description: Defaults false. When false effect is removed when animation ends

onActions.description: Automatically plays the animation on specified events. Options: move, attack, idle, underConstruction, underConstructionWithLinkedBuiltTime, queuedUnits, repair

onActionsQueuedUnitPlayAt.description: For onAction: queuedUnits. Amount queue needs to reach before starting, set between 0-1

blendIn.description: Blend with last animation for this time

blendOut.description: Blend with next animation for this time

pingPong.description: Play animation in reverse after it ends

KeyframeTimeScale.description: Scales all keyframe times, useful to make an animation faster/slower without changing everything

direction_units.description: Overrides [graphics]animation_direction_units while this animation is playing

neutralTeam.description: Spawn the unit on the neutral team instead of the same team as source

setToTeamOfLastAttacker.description: Spawn the unit on the last attacker of source (useful on [core]unitsSpawnedOnDeath)

spawnSource.description: Changes spawn location and team of spawned units to this unit ref.

gridAlign.description: Align spawn location to grid, useful for buildings

skipIfOverlapping.description: Don't spawn this unit if spawn in an invalid location. Eg on units or over water when LAND based

offsetX.example: spawnProjectileOnCreate: shot(offsetX=10, recursionLimit=0), shot(offsetX=-10, recursionLimit=0), shot(offsetY=10, recursionLimit=0)

offsetY.example: spawnProjectileOnCreate: shot(offsetX=10, recursionLimit=0), shot(offsetX=-10, recursionLimit=0), shot(offsetY=10, recursionLimit=0)

offsetRandomX.description: Random value to offset in the X axis only

offsetRandomY.description: Random value to offset in the Y axis only

offsetRandomDir.description: Sets random direction of the projectile

transportedUnitsToTransfer.description: Puts the designated amount of transported units into the transport of the spawned unit.

copyWaypointsFrom.description: Copies all waypoints on target to created units.

recursionLimit.description: Prevents loops, useful with spawning itself so it doesn't infinitely spawn, good for chain exploding. (Recommended no more than 4 if spawning more than 3 projectiles)

offsetRandomXY.description: The offset in both directions to randomly spawn, makes truly random spawning within an area

true.description: This value will meet the condition

false.description: This value will not meet the condition

if.description: Start all logic booleans with if, unless just using booleans (true/false)

and.description: Connector. Adds another condition to the list. All conditions linked by this must be reached to return true.

or.description: Connector. Adds another condition to the list. Just one of the conditions linked must be reached to return true
or.example: autoTrigger: if (self.energy>=2 or self.ammo>=1) and self.isFlying

not.description: Conditional. Reverts meaning of the next logic boolean. Useful to set negative conditions
not.example: if not self.isOverLiquid (the opposite of being over liquid)

thisActionTarget.example:
fireTurretXAtGround: mainGun (thisActionTarget==Marker with ground location)
alsoTriggerAction: x (thisActionTarget==Same as original action)
[turret]onShoot_triggerActions: x  (thisActionTarget==Target that was shot at)
takeResources_triggerActionIfAnyCollected: x (thisActionTarget==Target with resources)
addWaypoint_triggerActionIfMatched: x (thisActionTarget == Marker for move/Target for attack, etc. Note: use addWaypoint_maxTime:0 if you want to search only)

eventSource.description: Returns the event from autoTriggerOnEvent, null if used outside of a valid autoTriggerOnEvent

attacking.description: Current target this is attacking, might not be the current waypoint target.

parent.description: The transporter or attachment parent. (Note: units are suspended state when transported without attachment slot)

activeWaypointTarget.description: Current active waypoint target. Includes attacking, transporting, repairing, etc.

customTarget1.description: Custom memory, defaults to the unit that created this unit.

nearestUnit.description: (withinRange=500, withTag='x', relation='any') Search for a unit (not recommended in autoTrigger check for perfomance)

globalSearchForFirstUnit.description: (withTag=x, relation) - Returns first (and oldest) unit found matching the filter. Slow, avoid using in autoTrigger checks

nullUnit.description: returns a null unit reference, useful for comparisons

getAsMarker.description: creates a temporary marker at the position a unit is right now. Markers are very fast to create and automatically removed when no longer needed. Is not linked to any unit and still exists when the unit dies, and stays the same when source moves.

getOffsetAbsolute.description: ([x],[y],[height]) Returns marker with absolute offset (-y is north, +x is east)

getOffsetRelative.description: ([x],[y],[height],[dirOffset]) Returns marker with relative offset. (y+ is forwards)

readUnitMemory.description: Reads memory from the unit reference  (e.g. self.readUnitMemory, parent.readUnitMemory, attacking.readUnitMemory)
readUnitMemory.example: self.readUnitMemory('ammoType', type='string'), parent.readUnitMemory(''attachmentArray", type="unit[ ]", index=5), attacking.readUnitMemory("wishlist", type="string[ ]")[12]

anyRuleInGroup.description: (Only require 1 of the rules in this group pass, instead of all. Use the same group name on other placement rules to create a group.)

searchTags.description: Search for any unit with at least one of these tags

searchTeam.description: Teams to include in search, can be: own|neutral|allyNotOwn|ally|enemy|any

excludeIncompleteBuildings.description: defaults to false. Might want to set to true depending on the requirement reason

minCount.description: Set min amount of units that need to be found in search. (eg needs to be near something). Defaults to 0

maxCount.description: Set max amount of units before match fails (eg cannot be close to something). Defaults to unlimited

cannotPlaceMessage.description: Highly Recommended. Message shown to player if this rule fails (will be first failing rule if using anyRuleInGroup).

checkEachTile.description: defaults to true (set to false to only test unit center, true checks each tile under the unit which shows up on the placement grid. Can be easier to see requirements with true)

energy.description: Energy used for laser shield and ammunition

ammo.description: Hidden value on each unit for use by mods

setFlag.description: use with addResources, resourceUsage or price. 0-31. Flags are stored in each unit

unsetFlag.description: use with addResources, resourceUsage or price. 0-31

X.description: Any resource defined in [global_resource_x] or [resource_x] sections

displayName.description: Name of this resource in UI (eg hovering over unit info)

displayNameShort.description: Shorter version of resource name used on some text ui

displayColor.description: Color, can be hex with optional alpha

displayRoundedDown.description: Rounds off resource values with decimals

displayTextPrefix.description: Adds a string before the resource value

displayTextPostfix.description: Adds a string after the resource value

displayTextAppendResource.description: Appends another resource after this resource. It's recommended to give a "hidden" key on the appended resource to hide duplicate.

displayWhenZero.description: Displays the resource even when empty. Set as false by default

displayPos.description: Sets the position of the globa resource in the screen

iconImageUseInText.description: Default as true; Shows resource icon in action description

displayNameHideWhenIconShownInHUD.description: Hides the icon in menus referring to resource when true. Default as false

displayInHud.description: For resources used in appendResourceInHUD that shouldn't be hidden: true. Defaults true.

appendResourceInHUD.description: stacks another resource specified after this resource on the HUD.

appendResourceInHUD_whenThisZero.description: Defaults as true. When set as false, allows appended resource to be hidden with the parent resource.

displayPrefixInHUD.description: Displays text to show before resource value - replaces resource name and removes the colon separator

displayPostfixInHUD.description: Similar to the prefix counterpart, but is displayed after the resource value

valueInStats.description: Affects post game stats and replay leaderboard. Defaults to 1.

displayTextAppendResourceWithGap.description: Adds a space between this and the appended resource. Defaults as false.

displayDigitGrouping.description: Sets the symbol for separating place units in: none, comma, space

equivalentGlobalResourceForAI.description: Used to hint to the AI that a resource node with a local resources could be used to get a different global resource. Eg when a harvester unloads the resource

layer.description: Sets the layer of the decal, values from lowest to highest - shadow,  beforeBody, afterBody, onTop, beforeUI, inactive

order.description: Defaults as 0, sets a more discrete layering if 2 or more decals takes same layer type. Otherwise order in INI file will be used.

teamColors.description: When true, automatically reassigns team color to respective teams

onlyWhenSelectedByOwnPlayer.description: Defaults as false, displays the decal only if the owner player clicks on the unit

onlyWhenSelectedByEnemyPlayer.description: Defaults as false, displays the decal only if the enemy player clicks on the unit

onlyWhenSelectedByAllyNotOwnPlayer.description: Defaults as false, displays the decal only if the allied player clicks on the unit

onlyWhenSelectedByAnyPlayer.description: Defaults as false, displays the decal only if any player clicks on the unit

includeParentsSelection.description: Useable with onlyWhenSelectedBy[insertplayer], will also checks parent's selection when true. Useful with attachments.

onlyTeam.description: Draws the decal if value matches the player from the following: own, notOwn, ally, allyNotOwn,  enemy, any

onlyWhileActive.description: Draws the decal only if the unit is fully built

onlyWhileAlive.description: Draws the decal only if the unit is alive (If beforeUI layer default true, else default false)

onlyInPreview.description: Only show in sidebar, and building placement preview

onlyWithZoomLevelOrMore.description: Draws the decal only if the zoom level matches or exceeds it, very useful for making 3D units more optimized.

onlyOnNonPreview.description: Draws the decal only on the unit itself, not on the preview from building or in sidebar interface

onlyPlayersWithUnitControl.description: Draws the decal if a player that selects it has control (that includes shared units in multiplayer)

onlyOnBodyFrameOf.description: Only draw decal when body frame is equal to this

alwaysStartDirAtZero.description: Keeps the decal on north direction regardless of the unit's direction value,  useful for custom in-unit interfaces

imageStack.description: Takes one or more image with occassional multipliers for stacking. Also useful for using image stack from a MagicaVoxel slice export
imageStack.example: Multiple image file stack: imageStack - carFloor.png, carBody.png*3, carRoof.png*2, antenna.png*10

stack_hOffset.description: Sets the height of every layer in a stack. 1 layer = 1 pixel. Can take negative values.

stack_frameOffset.description: Useful for making 3D units, frame to offset by in imageStack. Often a value of 1 is useful in a sprite sheet.

stack_drawInReverseOrder.description: Renders the stack in the opposite way - last frame goes on bottom, first frame goes to top

stack_indexStart.description: Offset to start drawing images in the image stack

stack_indexCount.description: Number of images in the image stack to draw.

addBodyFrameMultipliedBy.description: Add body frame number to this decal when set to 1. Body frame number refers to the body sprite set in [graphics] image key

basePosition.description: Attaches the decal on the specified marker. use "self" if attaching it to the unit itself

basePositionFromLegEnd.description: Attaches the decal to the specified leg or arm ending.

basePositionFromTurret.description: Attaches the decal to the specified turret

drawLineTo.description: Draws a line from the unit to the specified marker, useful for custom waypoints

lineWidth.description: Sets the width of the drawn line

File.description: This file defines some of properties of a mod for display in mod browser and in Steam Workshop. It should be placed in the top of mod's file hierarchy, otherwise will result in error

title.description: Sets the title of the mod package

minVersion.description: Declares the minimum version compatible for the mod. It is important to declare one when using decals and other modding keys starting on version 1.15p9 beta

thumbnail.description: Sets the mod's thumbnail in Steam Workshop

requiredMods.description: What mod(s) required to use this mod, for stuff like dependent "DLC" expansions

requiredModsMessage.description: The message that displays if you do not have the mod necessary

sourceFolder.description: Sets where the custom music will be played for the mod

whenUsingUnitsFromThisMod_playExclusivel.description: Only plays music from this mod
